tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa bkra shis rdzogs ldan gyi sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab bklag mchog tu bkod pa'o// ༄༅// shrī lak+ṣ+mī sid+dhi rastu/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas// mgyogs par dga' la phan bya'i phyir// rab gnas cho ga mdor bsdus bshad// chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches yu gur gyi ban+de saṃ gha mi tra'i don du mdzad pa'i rab gnas mdor bsdus pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ sbyor ba rab tu gnas bya'i rten gang yin pa de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma zlum po bzhi/ bgegs gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ste drug bsham/ bum pa gnyis sam gcig spyi ltar bcas la mchod pa rnams oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med panam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi ta dang rol mo byas te byin dbab/ de nas bdag bskyed tshe dpag med sogs gang la mos shing bsnyen pa song ba zhig gi bsgom bzlas rdzogs par bya/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su bdag bskyed gang yin gyi lha gtso rkyang ngam/

'khor bcas gang rung rang rang gi gzhung bzhin bskyed nas mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba bum nang gi lha la phog pas thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dang sngags ci nus bzlas la mchod bstod bya/ spyi ltar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba'i chu bdud rtsir gyur par bsam pa'am/ bla med yin na dam ye phye mi dgos pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba'i chu bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ rnam rgyal bum pa ma grub kyang 'gal ba med de phyag rgya lngas dbang bskur ba'ang gsungs pas so// gang ltar yang las bum la lha bskyed mi dgos par/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa spros pas las bum gyi chu dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// bdag bum gnyis bla med kyi lugs yin na nang mchod sogs sgos chos rnams ma chad par bya dgos mod/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi spyi khyab tu 'jug bde dkyus kyi 'di tsam gyis 'thus pas 'dor len gang yang mi dgos so// de nas rten de la sbyang ba gsum bya ba ni/ sbyong chas kyi ting lo sbar nas mtheb kyu la chab bran/ dpon slob rnams lha'i nga rgyal gyis bzhengs te/ mchod g.yog pas mtheb kyu rten la bskor ba dang bstun/ mchog sbyin dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces zhi bas sbyang ba dang*/

slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing mchod g.yog pas ting lo dang chang bu rten la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha zhes sogs lan gsum byas nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la phyir dor ba zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang*/ de nas rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren gdul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/

hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'di

bdag bskyed gang yin gyi mtshan sbyar/ zhes bya ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rang rang gi gnas su songs shig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la/ rten gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ ngag tu/ sum+bha sogs dang*/ sarba bigh+nān u tsan+tā ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces drag tu brjod cing drag rol bya'o// yang*/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra zhes sogs nas 'gas par 'gyur ro// sum+bha sogs brjod do// de lta bu lan gnyis bya ba ni drag pos sbyang ba'o// bsdu na zhi ba dang*/ phyed ma'i sbyang ba'i rjes rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs bden brjod sbrel/ yang na bden brjod tsam bgyis kyang rung*// ༈ /shin tu bsdu na gzhung gi dngos bstan ltar/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab cing*/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nān u tsaṭ+ṭā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces btags pa yang yang brjod pas bgegs bskrad// ༈ /me long la shar ba'i rten gyi gzugs brnyan las bum gyi chus bkru zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba sogs/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba sogs/ de bzhin du/ sbyin pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ ser sna'i gnas su/ khrims 'chal/ khong khro'i/ le lo'i/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal rnams sbyar ba dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas bkru/ gang ltar yang mthar// ༈ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā zhes brjod cing dar ram/ ras dkar pos sku phyi ba'i tshul bya'o// de nas sku rten thor bu ba yin na/ las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ sku rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan nam/ khro bo rnams la ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rten gyi lha so so'i sa bon nam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs ma 'chol bar bskyed/ rten ngos mi zin pa dang*/ mngon rtogs mi 'khyor na thams cad 'og gi mchod rten ltar rnam snang du bskyed kyang rung bas/

de ltar na lha khang la logs bris can dang*/ sku rten dang*/ mchod rten rnams/ ༈ /swa bhā was sbyang*/ lha khang dang*/ sku rten dang*/ mchod rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa bskyed/ pusti sogs gsung rten rnams sbyangs/ gsung rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du āḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdor dril phyag mtshan sogs thugs rten rnams sbyangs/ thugs rten rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i khri/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dkyil thang yin na sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i lha gnas rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sogs gong ltar bskyed/ 'khor lo dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa sbyangs/ 'khor lo rnams stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bris pa'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ces dang*/ rta babs sogs sbyangs/ rta babs dang*/ rdo ring dang*/ skye mos tshal dang*/

rdzing bu la sogs pa rnams stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las lha rdzas las grub pa'i dngos po de dang de'i rnam pa can du gyur ces pas bskyed do// de nas lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs par bsams la/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod nas dam tshig pa la 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir dril bu gsil zhing*/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// sems can kun gyi don slad du// bdag gis 'byor pa nyid kyis ni// ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bas dgongs su gsol// kun gyis 'di la byin brlab cing*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs// zhes lan gsum brjod nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo bkug pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/

de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sbyar ba zhags pa'i dang*/ yang de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis gcig la gcig 'dud pa lcags sgrog gi dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug ste bskyod pa dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams rim bzhin bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha aḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa dang rten dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// srung 'khor sogs la ni 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes las grub pa'i 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs la bstim mo// skyed mos tshal la sogs pa la 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i dpal dang bkra shis pa'i dngos po de dag ji ltar bskyed pa'i rnam pas bkug cing bstim/ de dag kyang sngags dang phyag rgya gong du smos pa de nyid kyis so// de nas mi 'bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyi rgyas gdab/ rang dang rten gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs lngas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ rang gis rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gtor te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sku thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ bum pa med na phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo rdo rje dang 'dra bar gshib/

mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang ba rten gyi spyi bor gtug pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa dpral bar dang*/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa rna ltag g.yas par dang*/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor mnyam la lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba ltag par dang*/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba rna ltag g.yon par bzhag pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad la rigs lngas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// srung 'khor la sogs pa la ni dbang gi chu dang 'dres pas nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam pa'am/ phyag rgya bstan pa tsam las rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ni mi dgos so// de nas thal mo sbyar la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ snang gsal dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/ rol mo dang*/ shab+da rnams sbyar ba so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te mchod/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ bsdu na/ sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ༈ /'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gror gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen mchog gling skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyod la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor gru nub rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod do// gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rjes spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo// slar yang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs gong ltar dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/ sngags kyis mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rten rnams kyi thugs kar thim zhing*/ de las kyang 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs sngags kyi rnam pas rten de rnams la zhugs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang nus pa mnyam par bsam zhing*/ me tog lag tu bzung nas rten gtso gang yin pa'i sngags ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wam̐ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa swā hā/ zhes gang grub brjod pas/ nas 'bru re re nas ye dharmā'i yig 'bru gser 'od 'bar ba re rer gyur par bsams la/ ye dharmā dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhū khaṃ badz+ri bha wa dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rten de la me tog gtor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang me tog 'thor zhing*/ rten de rnams khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo// de nas mchod pas mnga' dbul bar bya ba'i phyir/

chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mor bcas rgya cher bshams pa rnams lha rdzas las grub pa sa dang nam mkha' bar snang khyab par byin gyis brlabs la/ gong du smos pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngags dang phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbul/ 'dod yon rnam pa lnga'i rdzas grub na dngos su bzung ba'am/ dbyibs su bris pa dbul zhing*/ rgyal ba zag med 'byor la dbang bsgyur yang*// 'gro ba'i don slad 'dod yon rnam lnga yis// mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do// rin po che sna bdun dbul zhing*/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro bas mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa'am/ so bdun ma sogs lag len ltar dgod cing*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ bud+dha k+ṣe tra bi shud+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod do// bstod pas mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs gong nas 'byung bas bstod/ de nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'i phyir/ thal mo 'dud pa'i rgyas gong du mngon par bsngags pa'i me tog thogs te/ lha de nyid kyi sngags sam yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis dkon mchog gi rten 'di rnams la rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa'i mthus/

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na rnam par bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad 'khor ba ji srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ bye brag tu'ang rten 'di rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du/ ye shes pa thams cad rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi skyabs gnas dam par mdzad cing*/ yon gyi bdag pos gtsor byas pa thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ ye dharmā bcas lan gsum brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ srung 'khor la ni bye brag tu'ang rten 'brel srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas 'chang ba po la bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol zhes bsgyur/ slob dpon gyis rten gyi spyi bor rdo rjes gtugs pa'am gtug par mos nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ sku rten la rnam snang 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ lha khang dang*/ mchod rten yin na/ rnam snang 'od du zhu ba las lha khang ngam/ mchod rten mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam pa can gyi nang du rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga la sogs sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ gsung rten la/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog gi rang bzhin glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ thugs rten la/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las phyag mtshan so so'i rnam par gyur/ ces so sor sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na/ bskyed pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ ces brjod kyang rung*/ dkyil thang ni sku rten gyi zhar la dmigs pa tsam gyis 'thus shing*/ 'khor lo sogs thor bu gzhan ni rnam pa de ka las bsgyur mi dgos so// slar yang*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ lha sku rnams la so so'i sgos bstod shes na sh+lo ka re res bstod/ mi shes na thun mong du/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bla ma dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yi dam dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sangs rgyas rnams la spyir bstod/ chos la/ dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ byang sems dang nyan rang sogs dge 'dun dkon mchog gi snang brnyan la/ grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ mchod rten la/ sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi// sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// chos sku'i rang bzhin can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ lha khang dang mchod rten gyi nang gi rigs lnga sogs la/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs dang*/ sgos bstod mi shes pa rnams la thun mong du/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo sogs sam/ mi shes na gong ltar 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs kyis bstod do// gtor ma chab kyis bran la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/

gtor ma dang po rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i rten de nyid kyis gtsor byas pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la a kā ro lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran tsam byas la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rang ngam yon bdag gang la mos pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs la/ so so'i gtor sngags kyis gtor ma 'bul zhing mchod bstod bya ba'am/ spyi tsam la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs gtor mgron spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe sogs lan gsum sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pas gtor ma dbul/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog ces phrin las bcol/ rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pas rten 'di rnams ji srid gnas kyi bar du srung mar mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo bar bya'o// de nas gtor ma gsum ni cha gsum gyi cho gas btang la/ drug pa ni/ gzhi bdag la dbul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug

oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las bcol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de nas bkra shis kyis mnga' dbul ba'i phyir/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis me tog bzung la/ rten 'brel snying po gang mang brjod pa'i mthar/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa gdab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mi mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// zhes pa tsam mam spro na mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis sogs kyang brjod mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig 'jig rten thams cad bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab pa dang rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o// ༈ /'thor nas dgos na skabs 'di'am/ gong gi brtan bzhugs kyi rjes gang bder bya/ de yang lha khang so sor sleb 'phral/ sum+bha sogs dang*/ sarba bi gh+nān sogs brjod cing yungs kar 'thor/ gu gul bdug ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas khrus gsol/

de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phyi/ brtan bzhugs dkyus su gsal ba ltar ram/ spyi 'gro'i tshig lhug pa'am tshigs bcad gang rigs tshar gsum re 'don zhing me tog 'thor/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas me tog 'thor zhing rol mo dang bcas gnas so sor phebs nas rang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ spro na slar yang brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod par bya'o// ༈ /de nas yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ sbyin bdag gis bla ma yon gyis mnyes par byas nas/ rten dang slob dpon gyi bar du stan bzang po la gos rgyan gzab 'phyor dang bcas thal sbyor gyis me tog bzung nas gus pa'i tshul gyis 'khod pa'i mdun du bla ma bzhengs shing yon gyi bdag po la 'di skad ces gdams par bya ste/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyis// ci bde bar ni mchod par byos// khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi/ khyod kyis rten 'di rnams la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas rgyun mi chad par mchod par gyis shig ces mchod par bsgo zhing gdan la bzhugs/ rten gyi drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod ci 'byor bshams pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs sam/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas te// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskangs la/

slob dpon gyis spro na yon bshad kyis mtshams sbyar ba'am/ gang ltar yang spyi sger gyi bsngo ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por bsngos te smon lam rgya chen po gdab cing*/ gtor ma'i mgron las cha gsum dang gzhi bdag ni so so'i skabs su gshegs zin pas/ chos skyong gi rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na des mtshon te mchod sbyin gyi gnas su lhags pa'i mgron glo bur la sogs pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// de nas sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa'i kha zas khur ba dang shing tog dang dkar gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'byor pa'i phud dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du phul la/ lhag ma dpon slob rnams dang yon bdag las byed bcas la drongs pa'i dga' ston la longs spyad cing*/ slar yang shis par bya ba'i slad du sbyin bdag rnams las bum gyi chu dang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can re rer gyur ces pa lta bus mtshon te bdag bskyed gang yin du skad cig gis bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sogs kyis khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod bcas dang*/ bden bdar lan gsum gyi tshe/ sbyin bdag 'khor bcas bkra shis par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas zhes bsgyur/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad la las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing*/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis re re nas thogs te/ tshig lhug pa rnams slob dpon gyis brjod/

tshigs bcad rnams thams cad kyis brjod cing*/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di rnams dang*/ sbyin bdag gis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad la me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te// rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyad pa'i// bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /rgyas bshad de bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par byas la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa srung gis gi wang phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar la/ gi wang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman// sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te// nyon mongs zung rngu med par gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i sogs dang*/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste// snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas// yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa dūrba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang*/ dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas// nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing tog bilba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang*/ bilba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun// byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi// bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig

/sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang*/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul// ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du bdag gyur te// chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi// bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang*/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te// chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs dang*/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste// mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /ces brjod/ re re'i mthar mchod g.yog gis mchod yon thams cad la 'grim zhing rten gyi drung du bsgrig bsdu na sbyin bdag lhar gsal ba'i rjes su sum+bha sogs brjod cing bgegs bsal/ rdzas rnams snod gcig tu bsgrigs pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ me long ye shes sogs tshigs bcad rnams kho na sbrel te brjod pa'i mthar rten gyi drung du 'jog gang ltar yang me tog 'thor zhing*/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med sogs mdo rgyud las byung ba'i shis pa brjod pa gang shes byas la rol mo'i sgra snyan par sbyar/ sbyin bdag rang gnas su gyes/ gal te sbyin bdag bsgo ba ma dgos na'ang rdzas brgyad byin rlabs man cho ga pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i srol yod cing*/ mi nus na bkra shis brjod pa tsam gyis kyang 'thus so// ༈ /de nas dpon slob rnams kyis bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba/

rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs kyis bsrung bas mtshon rang rang gi gzhung ltar dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs bsngo smon spyi dang*/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs gdab/ kha na ma tho ba rnams rten de nyid la bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pa ci nus su brjod nas/ las kyi rjes bsdu la chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o// ༈ /gal te dngos sta nyin gnyis ma'i dbang du byed na/ nyin dang po sta gon gyi skabs/ gong gi dbang bskur ba grub ma thag mkhyen par gsol bar bya ste/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ pus mo btsugs/ rdor dril spos dang bcas pa thogs nas/ 'di zhes bya ba'i

dmigs bsal rten gong du bskyed pa'i mtshan nas smos shing*/ spyi tsam du/ rdo rje gsum bdag bcom ldan 'das zhes sbyar bas rung*/ bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba// kun nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// rab gnas nangs par bgyid par 'tshal// tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa// kun gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas lha rnams dgyes bzhin du gnang bar byin par bsam/ spro na mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ gang ltar yang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams sang nangs par 'byon bzhed bzhin pas rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ zhes pas sku gzugs sogs bsrung zhing na bza' ser pos zhal dgab/ bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dkyus ltar bya/ nangs par tho rangs mchod gtor sogs gsar du bshams nas/ rten yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i rjes spyan dbye ba sogs gong ltar bya ba gsungs so// rgya che ba la tshig nyung zhing*// don che ba la tshegs chung ba'i// tshul 'di 'phags pas rnam phye ba// bdag gis ngag 'don phreng bar spel// dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun la// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po ru// rab tu gnas pa byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin la ngag 'don rnams tshig sna bsring zhing*/ brjod bde ba'i tshul du dge sbyong rgyal khams pa ngag dbang legs grub bam/ ngag dbang blo gros snying po gzhan phan mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer zhes bgyi bas mdo smad rdzong sar dgon du bris pa'o// //sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bhū yā ta// slar yang rang gzhan mang por sman pa'i bsam pa bzang pos sogs khongs rnams dkyus su bcug cing skabs 'gar gsal byed cung zad dang bcas bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bklags pas grub par sdebs pa dge/

༈ /bgrang phreng sogs rten phal pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i zin bris snying por dril ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus kun la sbyar rung gi nyer mkho 'ga' zhig btus te bri bar bya'o// de la bgrang phreng rab gnas ni/ gzhung der rigs so so'i bgrang phyed 'byed par gsungs mod/ de 'dra'i rnam dbye chags dka' na las 'jam po gsum la 'os pa'i bgrang phreng bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdo 'dzin badz+ra satwa zhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la 'od dpag med du bskyed/ drag po la 'os pa'i phreng ba bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ sogs brjod pas rdor sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mdzad nag po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ khro bo'i rgyan can du bskyed la/ de rnams gang la'ang phreng rdog rnams ni/ rang gi lha'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā pad+mo dha ri ṇi las rang rang gi lha gang yin par bskyed/ lha ye shes pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas thim par bsam/ de nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs cho ga gang la brten pa de'i lugs bzhin bya/ zhal bsgyur gyi skabs/ lha rnams zhu ba las zhi ba'i las la bsngags pa'i bgrang phreng gi rnam par gyur ces pa gzhan la'ang 'gre/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mi brjed pa'i gzungs su gyur cig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dharmāḥsu smṛ te su pra tiṣ+ṭha a pa ye hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas brtan par bya'o// ༈ /rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs rgyan la rab gnas byed na/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las trūm̐ las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/

sems dpa'i cha lugs can du bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs byas la/ zhu ba las rin po che'i rgyan gyi rnam par gyur ces brjod// ༈ /rgyal mtshan rab gnas ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zla ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gtsug lag khang ngam khang bzang la khyab pa'i sku rnam par snang mdzad spyi ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug pa nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas la/ gzungs thag btags pa bzung ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sūk+ṣ+me sūk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shān+te dān+te/ a sa mā ro be/ a na lam+bhe/ ta ram+bhe/ ya sho wa tī/ mahā te dza/ ni rā ku le/ ni rā wa ṇe/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha ta dīp+te dz+wā la dz+wā la dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swā hā/ zhes lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gi phreng ba de la gdags/ me tog dkar po'am/ ma 'byor na 'bras dang*/ dūrba la ye dharmā bzlas te gtor/ rnam snang zhu ba las rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/ ces dang*/ brtan bzhugs shis brjod sogs bya'o// ༈ /gdugs rab gnas ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar phyag gnyis kyis gdugs dkar po 'dzin par bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag rnam snang gi rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod sogs byas la/ oṃ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nī a tshat+t+ra ts+tsha ma l̥ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas la brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod sogs bya'o// rnga yab dang seng ge'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rgyal mtshan gyi bye brag mang po'i rab gnas kyang gsungs na'ang 'dir ma bris so// ༈ /ba dan rab gnas ni bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pām̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje ba dan nag po/

g.yas ba dan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i nyams dang cha lugs can du bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang rnam snang gi rgyas gdab pa sogs byas la 'od zhu yang snga ma'i rigs 'gre/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ke tu badz+ra pa daṃ ki a dhi tiṣ+ṭha pām̐ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la brtan bzhugs bya'o// ༈ /mtshe'u dang*/ rdzing dang*/ khron pa rab tu gnas pa ni/ de'i 'gram du rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma btang ste sgrub par gsungs pa ltar grub na legs/ 'dir cho ga gzhan la sbyar tshe chu de bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam snang du bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i chu lha dkar po mi'i gdong pa can sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can phyag g.yas 'gying ba dang bcas pas ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa/ g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad sbrul gyi rnam pa can du bskyed/ de la ye shes pa rnam snang bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod/ cho ga lhag ma rnams gang la brten pa'i de'i lugs ltar bya/ 'od zhu'i skabs su/ chu lha zhu ba las byung ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu/ dbang chen gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du khyab pa klu chen po brgyad bzhugs pa'i gnas su gyur par bsams la/ de'i dbus su mchod sdong gi shing*/ zabs su chu'i nyis 'gyur yod pa rtse mo chu lha'i gzugs can gzug ma 'byor na'ang nām̐ dgu las dbus su chu lha dkar po/ shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor pad+ma dmar po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du nor rgyas ser po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po sngon po/ shar lhor dung skyong ser po/ lho nub tu stobs kyi rgyu ljang gu/ nub byang du rigs ldan dkar po rnams bsams la/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos brgyan pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'o// ye shes pa gzhug pa'i dod du rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po dgu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la bstim/ gzhan sngar bzhin la rnam snang gi rgyas gdab/ dkar gsum dang klu sman gyis sbags pa'i mchod gtor rgya chen po bshams la klu chog gang rung gi sgo nas dbul/ rten 'di ji srid gnas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas sbyin bdag gi dpal dang longs spyod 'phel bar mdzad du gsol zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab la me tog 'thor zhing shis brjod sogs bya'o// 'di'i skabs kyi rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor dngos ni spyod rgyud mngon byang dang*/ yo ga'i kun rig lta bu/ bla med skabs su gtso bo go 'phos pa tsam gyis chog pas na shin tu mang ngo*// phyogs kyi gtor ma ni bzang po yongs bzung sogs nas 'byung ba'i don rgyas pa 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab las 'byung zhing*/ mdor bsdus pa gur gyi dkyil chog nas 'byung ngo*// ༈ /skyed mos tshal rab tu gnas par 'dod na/ phyogs kyi gtor ma byin la tshal de'i shing rnams bsang sbyangs/ shing gi gtso bo gcig rnam snang du bskyed/ gzhan 'dra ba la 'od zhu'i skabs su/ rnam snang zhu ba las shing gi tshogs su gyur par bsams la mchod/ 'bras bu zad mi shes pa dus dus su smin pa dang*/ kun la phan 'dogs pa'i don du yun ring du gnas par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod de/ bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol lo// gzhung 'dir rigs so so'i dril bu rab gnas bya ba'i tshul zhib par gsungs mod/ deng sang gnas bya'i dngos po dkon pas phyag mtshan spyi khyab kyi rab gnas mi bskyod pa bskyed pa des 'thus so// 'di rnams kyi gong 'og gi cho ga thams cad dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'am/ bdag bum tsam gang la brten pa'i de'i lugs ma 'chol bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni yo ga'i rab gnas bkra shis rab rgyas las rgyud sde kun la sbyar rung gi yan lag tu wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhas btus te sbyar bas sarba dik+ṣu maṅga la pra puṣ+ya tu//

༈ /rten gsar rnying la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga mdor bsdus snying por dril ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rten gsar rnying la bya ba'i ar+gha ste mchod yon gyi cho ga la gnyis/ rten gsar pa bzhengs pa'i mchod yon dang*/ rnying pa gso ba'i mchod yon gyi cho ga'o// dang po la bzhi/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du rdzing bu la sogs pa'i dang*/ sku gzugs dang*/ pusti'i mchod yon gyi cho ga'o// dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ gtsang khang byur bu dang*/ khang bzang dang*/ dgon gnas gsar pa brtsig par 'dod pas/ gza' skar tshes grangs bzang po 'dzom pa'i snga dro gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas sa brtag pa'i cho ga rgyud dang man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du brtags te/ mtshan nyid dang ldan par shes nas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsag rgyan dang cha lugs dang ldan pas sa'i dbus su sa dang ba lci bsres pas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la der dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa dang*/ phyogs skyong gtor ma'am cha gsum bsham/ de nas rang nyid lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bsgom/ bzlas pa dang*/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ phyogs skyong gtor ma'am cha gsum tshang bar gtong*/ de nas pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar te/ dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ mtha' skor du 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs la sogs pa mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur pa'i spyan sngar sa bslang bar bgyi'o snyam pas ngag tu/ khams gsum 'dir ni mgon gang dag /chen pos mchod pa bzhugs rnams dang*// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// dri za dang ni lha min sogs// de dang de la 'di gsol bgyi// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// sa yi cha ni mdzes pa 'dir// gtsug lag khang bzhengs 'byor pa la// thos bsam la sogs mchog 'jug pas// chos nyid rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// che ge bdag ni

rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// sbyin bdag blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi// zhes pa lta bu kha bsgyur bya/ che ge mo'i// grags pa dam pa bya bar brtson// gal te khyod kyis bzod gnang na// bgyid de gzhan du ma yin no// rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma yis// sa bzang 'di ni bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o// gtsug lag khang zhes pa'i gnas su mchod rten la sogs pa ming brjes la brjod do// de nas rmi lam brtag pa'i cho ga bya ba ni/ oṃ mu tsi li swā hā/ oṃ mo ha na swā hā/ i dan+ta li swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis lag g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags la/ rang gi sngas mgor bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i snang brnyan dngos su bshams pa'am/ yid kyis gsal bar dmigs pa'i spyan sngar mchod pa 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas mgo lhor bstan cing gdong shar du phyogs nas gos gtsang mas brgyan te nyal/ rmi lam ngan na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags sam chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bden med kyi sbyong ba'i rgyas btab ste/ slar yang rmi lam brtag pa byas nas lha rnams kyis gnang ba'am ma bkag par shes na bya/ bkag par shes na gnas gzhan du spo/ rmi lam bzang na nyi ma bzang po'i snga dro la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs rang gi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms la/ skyil mo krung bcas te lag pa sa la reg nas oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes pas sa gzhi stong par bsgom/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms la/ oṃ me di ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ sa lha'i mchod pa bshams pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūm̐ gsum bsams la ngag tu'ang brjod cing sor mo'i rtse mo sa la bsnun pas de'i 'od zer dang hūm̐ gi sgras sa bskul bas sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis na gser gyi bum pa dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/

rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa mngon du snang bar gyur par mos te/ oṃ pṛ thī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar bas puṣ+pe nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// bcom nas gtsug lag khang sogs bgyi// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas gyis shig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim ste sa'i ngo bor gnas par bsam mo// de nas spros pa dang 'brel na/ bdag bskyed lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms te bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bas stangs stabs rgyas bsdus gang rung gis bgegs bsang*/ gang ltar yang bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas kyi rjes sa gzhi stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang rang rang gi gzhung ltar bskyed/ der lha sta gon du bshad pa bzhin dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa dgod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ nye logs gang bder phyogs skyong gtor ma'ang bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs su rdzogs pa rang rang gi gzhung ltar bskyed pa'i mtha' skor phyogs skyong la sogs pa rnams kyang bzhugs par bsams la/ gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar dang*/ mchod bstod rnams sta gon ltar bya/ phyogs skyong la gtor ma cha gsum ltar gtong*/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur par bsams la/ g.yas spos phor dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyin bdag rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gtsug lag

/mgon po bdag nyid bgyid par 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags// de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni// gtsug lag khang chen bgyid par 'tshal// bdag dang sbyin bdag bcas pa la// thugs brtse bar ni nyer gnas te// tshogs pa thams cad rab

tshogs pa thams cad de sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rab tu gnas pa ste nye bar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang sogs la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i don yin pas 'di'i rab gnas zhes pa'i tshig la kha bsgyur mi dgos/ gnas pas// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems lha klu gnod sbyin rnams kyis dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin par bsam/ des mtshon te gtsug lag khang gi gnas su mchod rten sogs gang bzhengs par bya ba'i ming gzhug de nas spro na rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'am/ med na bum pa gzhan gyi nang du nya gson po gzhug las mi rnams bgegs mthar byed dam rdo rje gnod sbyin la sogs pa las thams cad pa'i lha gang yin du bskyed la/ de dag gis khung bu gru bzhi pa rgyar khru do pa zabs su khru gang pa'i dong brko bar bya'o// de'i byang shar du de dang tshad mnyam pa'am de'i phyed kyi tshad kyi dong zlum po brko bar bya'o// de gnyis ka sa dang ba'i lci bas byugs la/ de nas khung bu gru bzhi par oṃ āḥhrī pra ba ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing*/ mchod yon gyi snod kyi mchod yon dang rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pa'i chu blugs pas khung bu gru bzhi pa bkang nas de'i rgyun gyis zlum po yang dgang bar bya'o// de'i rjes su chu g.yas su 'khyil bar blta ste/ nya lcibs dang nya gson po gzhug shing 'o ma can gyi 'dab ma bcug la/ rang nyid dzam̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dza gu lī ser mo rtsa zhal ser mo/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i con pan can/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/

na bza' sna tshogs dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od mnga' bar bsgoms te/ oṃ dzām̐ gu lī sarba bi ṣa pra sha ma ṇi phu swā hā/ zhes bzla bzhin du pad kor lan lnga byas te dbang chen gyi bar du bltas pas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin sra zhing mkhregs par gyur par bsam/ nya gson po bcug pa gnod pa med pa'i gnas su bde bar bskyal lo// srung ba'i don du phyogs bcu'am byang shar gyi char phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa bsams la/ dkyil chog rnams nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong la phur pa gdab pa'i sngags kyis seng ldeng sogs phur pa bcu'am gcig gdab/ oṃ gha gha sogs bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis kyang brab/ phur pa rnams rdo la sogs pa'i sgrom du mi 'gul bar bzhugs su gsol/ slar gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs grub pa na phur bu dbyung ba'i cho gas dbyung*/ phur bu dngos su ma 'byor na yid kyis bsam yang rung*/ de nas lto 'phye brtag pa'i cho gas brtags la/ de'i mchan khung gi 'og gi cha brkor rung ba'i char thog mar brkos la/ de nas brtsams te g.yas skor du 'gram gding bar bya'o// sdong dum la sogs pa'i sa ro thams cad bsal la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ gnas de'i gzhi bdag dang*/ phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong ba'i lha/ me'i lha rnams zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis tshim par byas la zhi bar bya/ gtor ma dbul/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang*/ ltas mo pa rnams la ston mo dang*/ so rtsi sogs kyis tshim par bya/ bla ma la yon dbul/ bzo bo dang las byed pa rnams mnyes par bya'o// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten dang*/ gtsang khang byur bu dang*/ khang bzang dang*/ dgon gnas la sogs pa'i mchod yon gyi cho ga bsdus pa ste/ rgyas par spro na darban ā tsar+yas mdzad pa'i kri ya sa muts+tshar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rdzing dang khron pa sogs byed 'dod na/

gtor ma dang mchod yon sogs sngon du 'gro bas sngar bshad pa bzhin mchod yon byas la/ oṃ bam̐ badz+ra ba ru ṇa hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje chu bdag gi gzugs can rnam snang bsgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las klu rigs brgyad kyi gnas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod do// gsum pa ni/ sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i gnas der mchod gtor dang*/ gang bzhengs pa'i rgyu sogs legs par 'du byas la/ bdag bskyed gang rung bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sogs las 'byung ba'i dkon mchog gi mchod pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa mngon sum du bzhugs par bsams la/ ji snyed su dag sogs bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ gtor ma cha gsum gtong*/ de nas sku gzugs kyi rgyu shing ngam/ 'jim pa'am/ rdo dang*/ ras la sogs pa'i rdzas gang yin pa rnams las sngags kyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bzhengs par 'gyur ba'i lhar yan lag bzhi rdzogs la sogs pa'i cho gas bskyed/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir spos dang rdor dril thogs la/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das// zhes sogs gong du gtsug lag khang gi skabs ltar la/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can sku gzugs// zhes dang*/ bde gshegs sku gzugs bgyid par 'tshal// zhes bsgyur la gsol ba btab pas gnang ba stsal bar bsam/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas me tog 'thor/ lha bzo yang rang sdom gsum ldan pa'am/ de min skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sdom pa tsam la gnas shing bgegs mthar byed lta bu'i las kyi lha'i rjes gnang thob pa byung na mchog tu bsngags/ gang ltar yang*/ stan bzang po la 'khod pa'i mdun du pir dang tshon sogs lag cha gang yin rnams kyang 'bru dkar gyis bkang ba'i snod du bstar la bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las sku gang bzhengs par 'gyur ba'i rigs bdag gang yin pa'am bgegs mthar byed sogs las kyi khro bo'i skur yan lag bzhi rdzogs sam skad cig gis bskyed la gnas gsum brlab/ de'i lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re re/ de zhu ba lag pa la thim pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin dang*/ sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ pir la sogs pa de'i lag cha gang yin rnams dang*/ tshon thig dang tshon rtsi la spro na dkyil chog rnams las gsungs pa ltar thig tshon byin rlabs byas nas/ thig gdab pa'am tshon gyi bya ba rdzogs pa na so so'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol bar gsungs pa'ang snang ngo*// rtsi la sogs pa'i rdzas la oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes pa lta bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzlas la de'i lag tu gtad cing yig brgyas brtan par bya/ bkra shis brjod/ bzo bo 'dzugs ston gyis mnyes par bya zhing*/ dge 'dun la sogs pa la bsnyen bkur bas mtshon rgyab rim gyi dpung bskyed/ sngar rgyu la bsgoms pa'i lha la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bstod pa gang shes kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs spyan drangs pa'i lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang rgyu so so'i rnam par bsams la bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor/ 'di ni bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab kyi dngos bstan ltar bkod pa yin la/ de'ang kri ya sa muts+tshar/ thams cad du'ang 'dir bsgoms pa'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o zhes pa tsam gsungs shing*/ bu ston rin po ches sngar rgyu las bsgoms pa'i lha la mchod bstod byas nas gshegs su gsol zhes dmigs bsal rgyu las bskyed pa'i lha kho na gshegs su gsol bar gsungs/

yig cha gzhan 'ga' las bzo bo la bstims pa'i ye shes pa'ang gshegs su gsol bar gsungs pa dang*/ la lar rgyu'i lha gshegs su mi gsol bar/ de 'od du zhu ba las rang gi rnam par mos pa'ang gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang sku rten gyi rgyu dang bzo bo bcas spyir btang mi bskyod pa dang*/ mchod rten gyi rgyu dang bzo bo bcas rnam snang du bskyed pa'ang gsungs so// slar yang 'jim pa la spro na/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs nas 'jim pa la thim pas 'jim pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam zhing*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i steng g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du byas pa kha sbub tu bzhag la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sūk+ṣ+me sūk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shān+te dān+te/ a sa mā ro be/ a na lam+bhe/ ta ram+bhe/ ya sho wa tī/ ma hā te dza/ ni rā ku le/ ni rā wa ṇe/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di lan nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ gnas gtsang zhing dben par yig mkhan gdan bzang po la 'khod pa'i mdun du shog bu dang*/ smyu gu/ snag tsha rnams legs par bstar/ mchod pa bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin brlab/ yig mkhan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥlas snang ba mtha' yas su yan lag bzhi rdzogs sogs kyi cho gas bskyed/ oṃ a mi ta bhā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// zhes pa lta bus bstod/ de'i lag pa gnyis kyi sogs sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab/ shog bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid shog bu rnams la dhīḥyig dmar ser 'od 'bar ba/ de'i 'od zer gyis gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs nas shog bu la thim par gyur par bsam/ smyu gu dang*/ snag tsha la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dang*/ las sngags nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te/ smyu gu shes rab ye shes kyi bdag nyid dang*/ snag tsha rdo rje'i rdul phra rab yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ dhīḥshu ti smṛ ti bi dzā ya sarba ā dzñā na pa ṭa la a pa hā ri ṇi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes nyer gcig sogs bzlas pas mngon par bsngags nas yig mkhan gyi lag tu gtad cing*/ snag tsha'i snod shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang*/ smyu gu thabs kyi bdag nyid zung du 'brel bas gang zhig shes rab dang ye shes rnam par 'phro bas gang bris pa de rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid du yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsam/ yig brgyas brtan par bya zhing bkra shis brjod do// 'di la'ang kri ya sa muts+tshar bsgoms pa'i lha gshegs su gsol bar gsungs na'ang*/ bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab las ni gong du bkod pa kho na ltar 'byung ngo*// de ltar ji skad smos pa de rnams ni cung zad rgyas par bya ba'i tshul yin la/ mdor bsdus pa ni rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ rten gsar pa la ar+gha'i cho ga ni/ gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la ni sa'i cho ga rgyas par byas la/ de'i rjes la maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa rgya chen po bshams nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la/

'dir gtsug lag khang chen po dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba zhig 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'am/ mchod rten chen po byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bya'o// pusti dang bris sku la sogs pa byed na ras 'dul byas pa dang*/ shog skya lta bu'i drung du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ bdag lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan par bya/ ras sam shog bu'i steng du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod/ bris sku dang chos 'di lta bu la byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma btang ste de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ tshon dang*/ pir dang*/ snag tsha dang*/ smyu gu rnams la'ang de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la yi dam gyi lha'i sngags 'ga' bzla/ lha bzo dang yig mkhan yang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lta bu'i khro bo'i skur bsgoms la/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la gzhag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa rten rnying pa la bya ba ni/ grong khyer la sogs pa ru/ mchod rten dang sku gzugs la sogs pa rnying pa dang*/ gas pa dang*/ mes tshig pa dang*/ zhig pa la sogs pa la lha rnams gnas pas de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi yul zhig nas nags su 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ mu ge dang*/ grong stongs la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'byung bas zhig pa gso bar bya'o// de la rang lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rung dang ldan pas rten de'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bsham/ rten de nyid ye shes pa dngos su bsams la mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs spyi ltar sbyar la mchod pas mchod/ rten de gang la gnyer gtad pa'i srung mas gtsos spyi sgos kyi chos skyong dang gzhi bdag sogs la gtor ma btang la/

bdag gis sems can gyi don du bde bar gshegs pa'i rten snying pa spo ba'am/ zhig pa gso bar bya/ de'i phyir du sang nangs par rab gnas spo snyam du bsams la/ pus mo btsugs shing spos dang rdor dril bcas/ 'di zhes rten gang yin gyi mtshan nas smos te thub sku lta bu la/ shākya seng ge bcom ldan 'das// zhes pa lta bu'o/ bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rab gnas// mgon po nangs par spo bar 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags// de bas gnang ba mdzad par rigs// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// rig pa'i rgyal po 'di thub pa che zhes sogs bsgyur/ zhes bya// yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni// nangs par rab gnas spo bar 'tshal// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs brtse bar ni nyer gnas te// tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis snyan gsan phab pas dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin par bsams la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba rnams dkyus ltar bya/ sang nangs par rten gyi drung du mchod pa rgya chen po bsham/ de'i mdun du me long g.ya' dag pa zhig brtan par bzhag pa la rten gyi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug nas/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ rten rnying pa la mchod pa rgyas par bya/ gong gi tshigs bcad las/ nangs par zhes pa'i gnas su deng 'dir zhes bsgyur la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rten gyi lha dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan la thim par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya bzhis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes rten gyi lha me long gzugs brnyan dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la mchod bstod bkra shis gsol te/

dbu zhabs mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas la dar ser pos g.yogs la/ rgyab tu rgya btab la mchod khang du bzhugs la mchod pa dbul lo// bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dkyus ltar bya/ rten gsar pa tshar ba dang rab gnas dngos gzhi'i tshe me long spyan drangs la me long kha phye ste/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byed pa'i dus su me long nang gi rten rnying pa'i dam tshig pa ye shes pa dang bcas pa de sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgyas rten dam tshig pa la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ de'i rjes la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la sogs pa rab gnas bzhin rgyas par bya'o// de nas rten rnying pa'i rdo'i rigs chag grugs su gyur pa rnams ni chu bo chen po'i gzhung du bskyal/ der skyel mi nus na ri mthon po'i rtse mor phyin la der khung bu brkos la gzhug go /shing yin na mar gyis brlan pa'i gos kyis dkris la sbyin sreg gi me la bsreg go /zangs dang 'khar ba sogs yin na/ rten gsar pa bzhengs pa'i rgyu'i gseb tu bzhu la gtong ngo*// sa yin na gsar du bzhengs pa'i gseb tu gtong*/ gal te thag ring por spo ba yin na/ shing rta'i steng du gzhag glang khyu mchog gis drangs la bskyal/ de tsam yang mi nus na chu bo chen po'i gzhung du gtong*/ de'ang mi nus na de nyid kyi nye logs su sa gzhan dang ma 'dres par mchod rten byas nas rab gnas byas la gzhag go /rten 'dre can gyi rgyu ni gsar par mi bsre bar drag po'i bsreg blugs kyis sbyangs nas thal ba chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o// de ni rten rnying nas chag grugs su gyur pa gso ba la/ rten gsar pa sngar bas tshad mi chung zhing rgyu mi zhan pa la bya rung gi/ tshad chung zhing rgyu zhan pa la ni byar mi rung ngo*// rnying pa min yang chung ba che ru gtong ba dang*/ rgyu ngan pa bzang du gtong ba la ni byar rung ngo*// gnas 'o brgyal ba'am/ 'jig pa'i nyen dang bcas pa nas 'o mi brgyal zhing 'jig pa'i nyen med sar spod pa dang*/

tshad mnyam pa'am lhag par bzhengs pa la rung gi/ rang gi 'dod pa'i sa cha der mi mkho bar shes pa'am/ nang gzhug sogs la rngams pa dang*/ grub mtha'i kun slong ngan pas bshig nas spod pa yin na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gyur bas rnam pa thams cad du mi rung ngo*// slob dpon a bhā yas ni rten rnying pa'i ye shes pa la mchod bstod byas/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang nas/ rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol bar 'dod do// 'di rnams kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab las 'byung ba'i don cung zad gsal bar bkod pa yin la/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ de'ang rten de'i spyan sngar gtor ma dang mchod pa rgya chen po bshams la bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod do// bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bde bar gshegs pa'i rten rnying pa spo ba'am gso bar 'tshal zhing*/ de'ang sang nangs par bgyid par 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba gdab/ de bzhin du chos skyong srung ma rnams la'ang gtor ma btang la gsol ba gdab/ yang sang nangs par rten gyi spyan sngar mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas te gtor ma dang mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod de snga ma bzhin du brjod/ sang nangs par zhes pa'i skabs su da ni rab gnas spo bar 'tshal zhes pa gzhug de nas me long g.ya' yongs su dag pa zhig la rten gyi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la gang zag khyad par can gyis byas pa'i rten yang me long gi nang du spyan drangs pa la bzhugs su bcug dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' bcug la me long gi nang du gzhug de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rten de bden na me long gi 'di'ang bden/ me long gi mi bden na rten 'di'ang mi bden te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'am me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de nas me long gi rten de la mchod bstod bsdus pa tsam zhig byas la/

steng 'og mi 'khrul ba'i mtshan ma byas te dar ser po sogs kyis g.yogs la rgyab ngos su rgya btab la/ rten gsar pa tshar nas rab gnas byed byed du kha mi dbye bar mchod pa bzang sar bzhugs su bcug ces gsungs shing*/ rten rnying pa ji ltar bya ba dang*/ gsar pa grub pa'i tshe me long gi rten de la gzhug pa sogs gong du bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra bar gsungs/ de la kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges gsal byed mdzad par/ rten gyi drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ rang yi dam gang 'dod kyi bsgom bzlas rdzogs par bya/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin brlab/ tshigs bcad gang yang rung bas mchod/ rten de nyid kyi bstod pa'am/ spyi bstod gang rigs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin brlab/ a kā ros chos skyong la dbul/ bdag gis sems can thams cad sogs gong ltar snyan gsan dbab pa ni sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs snyan gsan dbab pa yan sngar ltar rjes me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba la yid gtad de/ rten 'di gang zag khyad par can gyis rab gnas byas pa yin yang me long gi gzugs brnyan la spor rung ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ rten 'di bden na sogs gang ltar bsam/ de nas me long nang gi gzugs brnyan la dmigs te rten dam tshig par bskyed/ pusti sogs la dang po'i bsgyur gzhi gang yin de bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ rten rnying pa'i ye shes pa gzhug mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas rgyas gdab pa sogs gong ltar gsungs so// 'di la 'ga' zhig gis rten rnying pa'i ye shes pa me long gi gzugs brnyan la bstim dgos par ma zad/ dam tshig pa'ang bstim dgos te/ dam tshig gi rten de gzhig dgos pa'i phyir gsungs kyang*/ rten gyi dam tshig pa dang*/ me long gi gzugs brnyan dbyer med du shes pa'i chos nyid la blo bzhag pas skyon du mi 'gyur bar sems so// de ltar rten gsar rnying la bya ba'i cho ga 'di rnams la/

kri ya sa muts+tsha'i 'gyur dang*/ bu ston rin po che sogs kyis ar+gha ste mchod yon gyi cho ga zhes gsungs pa ni lhag pa'i lha la mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas snyan gsan dbab pa'i cho ga yin pas de skad ces bya/ yang rgya bod kyi dpe 'ga' zhig la arka'i cho ga zhes 'byung ba ni/ sgra de rin thang can la 'jug pas/ 'jim pa sogs kyi rgyu dman pa las bde bar gshegs pa'i snang brnyan 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod sdong dpe zla med pa'i rin thang can du bsgrub pa'i ched gnang ba zhu ba'i cho ga'am/ rten rnying pa zhig ral can sogs gsar pa khyad par 'phags par bskrun pa'i ched gnang ba zhu ba'i cho ga zhes btags par sems so// zhar byung gtsug lag khang sogs rgya chen po bzhengs pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i zin thun cung zad 'bri na/ thog mar shing gcod pa'i skabs kyi cho ga ni/ slob dpon shing bzo dang bcas gza' skar dus tshod bzang ba'i snga dro nags tshal du phyin/ rang nyid bgegs mthar byed kyi bsgoms bzlas sngon du 'gro bas shing mkhan las byed dang bcas pa'ang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsrung zhing kha shar ram byang du phyogs pas shing la brtag par bya ste/ sa gzhi bzang por skyes shing mdog legs shing snum pa/ drang zhing mkhregs pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu dang dri zhim pos brgyan cing yal ga rgyas pa sogs blang bar bya la/ yal ga yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i lcug phran dang*/ 'khyogs pa dang*/ rgas pa dang*/ skam pa dang*/ gcig pur skyes pa dang*/ yal ga chag pa dang*/ gas pa dang*/ mes tshig pa dang*/ 'dab ma snyil ba dang*/ dur khrod dang khung bu dang lha'i gnas dang lam gyis mdo dang mi gtsang ba'i yul du skyes pa dang*/ mtshe'u dang*/ chu klung gi ngogs su skyes pa dang*/ bya dang sbrul gyis tshang bcas pa dang*/ thog gis bcag pa sogs ni spang bar bya'o// de ltar legs par brtags nas/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sar mchod pa dang*/

gtor ma bsham/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkha' khyab tu bzhugs par bsams la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bya bas gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i ched du phyogs 'di nyid sgrub par byed na bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams yongs su spel ba'i slad du gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan gyi don la spro bas ci bde bar longs spyod cig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas grub na phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma'am/ ma grub na cha gsum spyi ltar gtong*/ 'dod gsol skabs/ sa phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nags tshal gyi lha la sogs pa thams cad kyis bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bya bas bsod nams kyi slad du gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzhengs pa'i phyir shing bslang na dga' ba dang*/ dwang ba dang*/ gus pa'i bsam pas sbyin par gyis shig ces brjod/ bzo bo sogs dga' ston gyis tshim par bya zhing*/ bdag bskyed bsdus te nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas rmi lam brtag nas ngan na bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bzlog cing*/ des kyang ma bzlog na gzhan du spo/ gnang ba'am bkag pa'i mtshan ma thob na ji ltar rigs par longs spyad par bya ste/ nags tshal gyi mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ rnam snang sogs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas shing gi rigs so so'i dbye bas de la gnas pa'i ma mo dang zhing skyong rnams so sor gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs kyang de 'dra'i rnam dbye chags dka' na/ gdan bzhi las gsungs pa'i gtor chen nam/ gur gyi phyogs bzhi gtor ma'am/ bde mchog sogs las 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bsdus pa btang ba'i rjes/

gtsug lag khang sogs rgyu ru ni// de ring shing gcod bdag spro bas// khyed rnams da ni bzod mdzad nas// shing gzhan la ni gnas par mdzod// ces lan gsum gyis 'dod don gsol bas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar longs spyod cig ces dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin nas gcad bya ma yin pa'i shing gzhan la gnas bcas te song bar bsam/ slar yang de la dmigs te mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ shing gcod pa po bgegs mthar byed du bskyed la kha zas bzang pos tshim par byas te/ s+t+wa re'i so la las sngags kyis bsngags pa'i sbrang rtsi byugs te lag g.yas su gtod nas/ dge ba'i yid kyis shar dang byang du phyogs pas nyi ma la blta zhing bcad/ de rnams bsrung ba'i ched du rang ngam gzhan gyis rma bya chen mo'i gzungs bklag shing 'gyel ba'i tshe me mtshams su 'gyel na me dang*/ lhor 'chi ba dang*/ lho nub tu nad dang*/ chu dang rlung gi phyogs su 'gyel na de dang de'i 'jigs pa 'byung zhing*/ phyogs gzhan du 'gyel na dge zhing shis pas blang bar bya la/ shing gzhan la 'khren pa dang bcas 'gyel ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang bcas ring du song ba sogs ngan pa yin pas spang bar bya ba'am/ mi nus na de lta bu la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i bum chus gtor bas zhi bar bya'o// de bzhin du blang ba'i skabs su/ shar ram byang du kha bltas pa'i sa dkar zhing snum la gseg ma sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba'i gzhir phyin la kha shar ram byang du phyogs pas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gtor ma cha gsum dang*/ chab gtor gtong*/ lhag par sa bdag lha klu rnams la dmigs te/ dkar gtor mchod pa bcas bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/

oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā sogs kyis mchod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am ni gzhan// de dag rnams la sa 'di ni// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis 'dod don gsol bas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar longs spyod ces gnang ba byin par bsams la/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥs rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ tshon skud la/ oṃ badz+ra su tra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas ji tsam brko dgos pa'i rgya tshad de bskor la/ de'i mthar phur bu dngos su btab pa'am yid kyis btab pas bgegs rnams la phur bus gdab par bsam zhing*/ oṃ kī li kī lā ya badz+rī badz+rī bhū ra bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ yungs dkar dang dri bzang gi chu bsres la las sngags brjod pas phyogs thams cad du gtor bas rin po che'i sa gzhir bsam/ las byed pa bgegs mthar byed du bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ zhes ji tsam 'dod pa thig gi mtshams las mi 'da' bar brko bar bya'o// brtsig pa'i ched rdo blang ba ni/ shar dang*/ byang dang*/ byang shar dang*/ steng du phyogs pa'i rdo mkhregs shing kha dog bzang ba btsal/ mchod rten gyi nye 'khor dang*/ dur khrod dang lam gyi bzhi mdo dang*/ kha dog dmar po dang*/ rul ba dang*/ srog chags mang ba sogs spang byar gsungs/ blang ba'i tshe gtor ma cha gsum sogs btang zhing*/ las sngags bzla bzhin blang ngo*// gtsug lag sogs bya ba'i gzhir sa sel yod na dbyung ba dang phur bu gdab pa'i cho ga rgyas par kri ya sa muts+tsha sogs las 'byung ba ltar bya/ de tsam mi nus na/ de dag gi skyon sel bas mtshon phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par bya ba'i don du dbus dang phyogs mtshams su klu chen dgu'i bum pa dang*/ gzhan yang rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa ci rigs pa sbas/ 'on kyang ye shes pa'i rigs bskyed bstim bgyis pa'i bum pa ni rtsig pa sogs kyi logs su sbas na legs/

rtsig pa'i pha gu'am/ rdo'am/ des mtshon te gyang btang ba sogs kyi tshe/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bud+dha ā la yaṃ dhi tiṣ+ṭhān+tu swā hā zhes so so'i zur la lan bdun sogs bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ sgo 'dzugs pa'i skabs/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang bcas hūm̐ las byung ba'i sgo dad pa'i dbang po la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ dag pa'i bsam gtan gyi rang bzhin mdzes pa'i rta babs dang ldan par bsams la rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas brlabs te/ shar sgo gshin rje gshed/ lho shes rab mthar byed/ nub pad+ma mthar byed/ byang bgegs mthar byed kyi ngo bor bsams la so so'i sngags bzla/ lha'i ngo bor gyur pa'i sgo de nyid la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang rten 'brel snying pos brtan par bya/ ka ba hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ka bar gyur par bsams la rnam snang gi gzungs bzla bzhin gzug dbus su gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'am hūm̐ mdzad dang*/ phyogs mtshams rnams gshin rje mthar byed sogs rang rang gi khro bo chen po'i sngags rnams kyis lan brgya rtsar mngon par bsngags te me tog 'thor/ shis brjod sogs bya/ gdung ma la sogs pa'i shing dgod pa na hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams la phyogs so so'i khro bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzla zhing dgod/ thog dbub pa ni/ shing lo gsar pa dgram zhing rigs byed ma dang klu chen dgu sogs kyi sngags bzla/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i sngags brgya rtsa sogs kyis brlab/ gtor ma dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs bya zhing*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i sgo nas gzungs sgrub bgyis pa'i bum chus phyogs thams cad du gtor ba dang*/ gdugs dang 'phan la sogs pas kyang brgyan la shis pa rgya cher brjod/

dga' ston bya/ gañdzi ra sogs 'dzugs pa'i tshe/ de nyid mchod rten gyi ngo bor rnam par brtags te dri med rnam gnyis kyi cho ga tshul bzhin bgyis na'ang mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ gang ltar yang gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi tsakra dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi glegs bam sogs bris la so so'i 'dzugs chog ltar mnga' gsol/ thog dang sa g.yos srung ba/ nad dang 'khrug pa zhi ba/ nor dang 'bru 'phel ba/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'du ba sogs las 'jam po gsum gyi 'khor lo'i rigs bri sgrub tshul bzhin du bgyis pa dang gter bum gyi rigs sogs so so'i cho gas bzhugs su gsol na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// rgyal mtshan sogs 'dzugs pa'i tshe/ rin po che'am/ 'jim pa'am/ shing dang*/ dar zab sogs las byas pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi nang du gzungs gzhug spyi dang*/ gdugs dkar dang so sor 'brangs ma'i 'khor lo dang gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i gzungs kyi glegs bam sogs bcug nas rab tu gnas te de dang de'i sgo nas 'dzugs pa'i cho ga bye brag tu bya zhing*/ spyir btang tsam la/ gtsug lag khang sogs kyi steng thog shar gyi char rgyal mtshan gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang skud pa lngas bcings te brtan par bzhag pa'i mdun du mchod pa'i bye brag rgyas par bstar/ rang gi mdun du khrus bum sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'byor na gdugs dang rol cha sogs ser sbreng yang sta gon du byas nas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas khrus bum bsgrub/ rgyal mtshan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchod rten gyi rnam pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro bar gyur par bsam/ sbyang ba gsum dang*/ khrus gsol/ sku phyi rnams bya/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa sogs kyis mchod/
